question: 多智能体投票的端到端延迟T_total = T_inference_max + T_aggregation，其中T_inference_max = T_single * L_eff(N)（取最慢智能体时间），T_aggregation ≈ 0.5s（固定聚合开销）。对于N=3，若T_single=5s，T_total ≈ 5*1.2*3 + 0.5 = 18.5s；对于N=5，T_total ≈ 5*1.3*5 + 0.5 = 33s。

sources.title: Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism: Throughput-Latency Trade-off
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT Large Language Model (LLM) serving systems must balance latency and throughput while efficiently utilizing distributed GPU resources. This challenge arises because inference consists of two fundamentally different phases: prefill, which determines time-to-first-token (TTFT), and decode, which determines inter-token latency (ITL).
